request: Fix the mobile New thread Recent list in Aura: it currently sits directly on the wallpaper with an opaque sticky header band and rows with no separation, which the user dislikes. Render it as an intentional themed card below the wallpaper (rounded surface, bordered, readable in light and dark), with the Recent heading above a hairline rule and hairline dividers between rows instead of the solid band; keep the scroll behavior, keep desktop unchanged, bump Aura to 0.2.8, then release the new version with a PR, merge it, and push the aura/v0.2.8 tag.
message: Verification: workspace check passes (36 Aura tests); independent fresh-context browser QA at 390x844 light+dark and 1440x1000 confirms the inset Recent card, hairline heading rule, row dividers, 11.6:1 dark contrast, and desktop unchanged, with screenshots.

reasons.integrated: integrated has not been proven by a durable receipt.
reasons.delivered: delivered has not been proven by a durable receipt.
reasons.published: published has not been proven by a durable receipt.

sizeDecision.reason: One CSS surface change in one constant plus its tests; a split would leave the mobile list half-styled and the release tag waits on the same visual change.
